corrected: Every $2$-colouring of the edges of a large complete graph contains a monochromatic $K_k$. The Ramsey number $R(k)$ is the threshold; $\sqrt2^{\,k} \le R(k) \le 4^k$ for $k \ge 2$, improved to $(4-\varepsilon)^k$ in 2023.
